text: Hey there. I was stuck abroad during the last wave of war, with an A5 visa. I bought a ticket on one of ElAl's rescue flights. My original ticket back was with Wizzair, so I wasn't on their waiting list. But after they fill the "rescue" spots, they open tickets for public, and this is how I got in - and since it was a rescue flight, it was kept on schedule even when ElAl cancelled hundreds of other flights that week. My Israeli ID was my main ticket though :) They don't allow tourists in, they also said that all working visas were cancelled at the time, just the ones with an IL ID got through. I did. That's what I can tell from my experience.
